_comment: Inputs qbox-catalog cannot derive from QBox sources. 'args' gives the class (or module type) of each sc_object* constructor argument, in order. 'params' are presets the constructor refuses to run without; their values are placeholders for introspection, not recommendations. 'note' is copied into the catalog.

vhost_user_vsock_pci.note: With exec_backend true (the default), vsock_device_backend_path must name the vhost-device-vsock executable.

display.note: Argument is the GPU device to display.

vnc.note: Argument is the GPU device to serve; gpu_output selects the head and must be set (QBox's error message calls it display_index).

arm_gicv2m.note: Second argument is the GIC whose SPIs the MSI frame raises.

riscv_aclint_swi.note: The second constructor argument is accepted but unused.

generic_lua_model.note: Arguments are a container holding a reg_router and a gs_memory for the registers; not introspected.

component_constructor.note: Loads the shared library named by node_exe_path (and needs node_name) in its constructor, so it cannot be introspected without a real component.

python_binder.note: Imports the Python module named by py_module_dir and py_module_name in its constructor, so it cannot be introspected without a real module.

ContainerWithArgs.note: Generic container that takes its parent container as argument; not introspected.
